name: Web UI Info
author: LEDMatrix
description: Displays the web UI URL for easy access. Shows 'visit web ui at http://[deviceID]:5000'

versions.notes: Load the 4x6 detail face on its 7px pixel grid. 4x6-font rasterises cleanly only at whole multiples of 7; at ppem 6 the 1-bit (fontmode "1") mono rasteriser thresholds every glyph down from 4px wide to 3px, so W/M and 0/8 lose the pixels that tell them apart, and getlength returns a fractional advance whose value depends on the installed FreeType -- two boards on one config measured the same string up to 17% apart. Same grid football-scoreboard keeps in _FONT_PIXEL_GRID.

Remove the transition.* block: three of this plugin's five settings did nothing, and the core implements no display transitions (#381). A config.json still carrying them fails validation until it is saved again, hence the major.

versions.changelog: Render text 1-bit (no anti-aliasing) so glyphs stay crisp on the LED grid
